description: Short-scale fork of exp354 (graded upper out_proj tph [2048, 2048, 1024, 1024, 512, 512]). n_steps 100K -> 25K, batch_size 32 -> 8. Direct comparison to exp352 (graded-lower [1024..256], val=1.3708) and exp329_cfc (uniform tph=1024, val=1.3787) at matched short-run budget. Tests whether upper-graded advantage (exp354 best=1.2196 vs exp351's 1.2457 at 100k) already manifests at 25k bs=8 or is scale-dependent.
